I have some schooling so I can read the writing on a fertilizer bag, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer for only 0.06 hectares because one bag costs too much and is more than my small plot needs. Since this land is my own, I will put cow manure and compost around the trees like I did last year, and I will weed by hand with my family. We will spend about 30 days working this plot over the season, and I will not hire outside labor because I do not have cash for wages.
